sloka: स निवृत्तो गुरोर्वाक्यान्मरुत्तः पृथिवीपतिः ।विसृज्य सशरं चापं स्वस्थो मखमुखो ऽभवत् ।। ७.१८.१९ ॥
transliteration: sa nivṛtto gurorvākyānmaruttaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।visṛjya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ svastho makhamukho 'bhavat ।। 7.18.19 ॥

translations.english: Following his guru's words, King Marutta turned back, abandoned his bow and arrows, and became composed and intent on his sacrifice.
